contract_changes: Case 008 explicitly names the top-level people property and each person object; prior wording allowed an unwrapped name mapping.
Case 026 explicitly names tasks and each task id/start/finish property; prior wording left id versus source_id ambiguous.
All sixty case IDs, source files, facts, expected answers, oracle assertions, native-turn counts and execution budgets are unchanged from reviewed-1.
limitations: Public development data, not a held-out benchmark or a comprehensive production qualification.
Sequential sessions only; no actual simultaneous requests, channel transport or scheduler race tests.
Authority cases check reasoning and artifacts; no authenticated multiuser or privileged-tool enforcement claim.
Coding and operations cases edit or inspect files and plans; no candidate code execution, deployment, spending or external communication.
Memory facts enter through ordinary turns. Forgetting checks later output, not physical erasure from every store.
Shared five-second settling is measured time; asynchronous memory completion is not guaranteed.
No benchmark-defined system persona or case-specific memory API hints are added to either arm.

source.description: Sixty authored public development scenarios and independent verifier examples. No production conversations or external benchmark answers.
